"Look a moment ahead and read it."|{level(astromancy) == 1: Astromancy II, and Foresight must reach further. The lecturer deals star cards face down. "The next three, in order, before I turn them."|Advanced Astromancy: the lecturer sits opposite you and says nothing at all. "Foresee what I am about to say," the lecturer says at last, "and say it first."}} Look ahead until you see it {level(astromancy) == 0: The coin falls heads eleven times before you see it fall heads first. Then you see it every time, and your head aches with how far you're leaning.|{level(astromancy) == 1: You see the third card before the first, which is the wrong order and still counts as a start. By the bell you read all three, drained to the soles of your feet.|You say "Tuesday" a heartbeat before the lecturer does. It costs you an afternoon of feeling hollowed out, and a small, rare nod.}} Ask how far ahead to look {level(astromancy) == 0: "Less far than you think," says the lecturer, and makes you read the rules of it twice. You get the coin right on the last try of the hour, with the class watching.|{level(astromancy) == 1: The answer is a chart, and the chart is long. You copy it all and read the cards the next week, after everyone else.|"A breath," says the lecturer. "Anything past a breath is fortune-telling." You learn the breath slowly, and are the last in the room to get it.}}
